title: Four-Square Distribution OQ-04: Orbit-Surjectivity of Value-Multiset Tuples
description: Discharges the combinatorial residue at the heart of the multiset-arrangement count: two tuples g, h : Fin m → ℤ with the same value-multiset differ by a permutation (exists_perm_comp). The proof is a canonical-form argument via Tuple.sort — two sorted lists that are permutation-equivalent are equal — supplying the orbit-surjectivity underlying the remaining sorries of FourSquareDistributionOQ04ArrangeProof. 0 axioms, 0 sorries.
